project_info.theme: Techcombank merchant reward campaign for accepting payments
project_info.color_palette: White, black, red, warm beige, gold

main_subject.detail: A smiling middle-aged female shop owner in a white shirt and bright red apron stands inside a restaurant or cafe, holding a smartphone payment device in one hand and a large red gift box in the other. The open box glows and contains a modern smartphone, gold bars labeled '999.9', and red U-point tokens. The headline reads 'San iPhone 17, vang PNJ va hang trieu diem U-Point' with subheadline 'Khi nhan thanh toan qua Techcombank'. Behind her is a blurred dining area with customers, a QR standee, counter POS terminal, and an angled phone screen showing '1,000,000'.
main_subject.style: Warm merchant-success poster blending realistic portrait photography with glossy prize-box 3D reward elements

composition_elements.text: TECHCOMBANK / San iPhone 17, vang PNJ va hang trieu diem U-Point / Khi nhan thanh toan qua Techcombank / 999.9 / 1,000,000 / VUOT TROI MOI NGAY / (*) Ap dung theo dieu kien, dieu khoan chuong trinh
items: Top Left: White negative space above the restaurant interior
Top Right: Techcombank wordmark and red logo
Bottom Left: 'VUOT TROI MOI NGAY' lockup beside the glowing reward gift box
Bottom Right: POS terminal, smartphone screen showing payment amount, and legal footnote

Center/Background: Female merchant portrait in front of a softly blurred dining space with QR stand, while an oversized open gift box floats in the foreground containing iPhone, gold bars, and red U-point tokens

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Warm ambient restaurant glow, gentle facial retouching, luminous prize-box bloom, shallow depth-of-field background blur

technical_specs.render_style: Photoreal portrait compositing with 3D reward props for a banking campaign

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Techcombank merchant reward campaign. Centerpiece is a smiling female merchant in a red apron holding a phone while presenting a glowing oversized red gift box filled with an iPhone 17-style smartphone, 999.9 gold bars, and red U-point tokens. Background is a softly blurred cafe or restaurant interior with seated customers, a QR payment stand, and a POS counter setup. Surrounding elements: Techcombank logo, exact headline 'San iPhone 17, vang PNJ va hang trieu diem U-Point', subheadline 'Khi nhan thanh toan qua Techcombank', visible labels '999.9' and '1,000,000', bottom-left line 'VUOT TROI MOI NGAY', and the legal line '(*) Ap dung theo dieu kien, dieu khoan chuong trinh'. Technical style: photoreal portrait compositing with 3D reward props for a banking campaign, soft indoor commercial portrait lighting, warm ambient glow and shallow depth-of-field blur, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
